item.title: Russia poisoned Alexei Navalny with dart frog toxin, European nations say
item.description: LONDON (AP) — Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny was poisoned by the Kremlin with a rare and lethal toxin found in the skin of poison dart frogs, five European countries said Saturday. item.title: Man rescued at Waimea Bay; busy holiday weekend keeps Ocean Safety crews active
item.description: Honolulu Ocean Safety lifeguards performed CPR on an unresponsive man at Waimea Bay Saturday afternoon. The rescue comes as crews report 23 rescues across East Oʻahu beaches during the busy President’s Day weekend.
